name: terminal-relay
description: Let AI agents and scripts run commands in your VS Code / Cursor terminal and read back the output.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Terminal Relay runs commands in your terminal, so it only runs in trusted folders.

terminalRelay.logAllTerminals.markdownDescription: Also log commands and output of terminals you opened yourself, not only the ones Terminal Relay opened. Logs can contain secrets you type or print, and agents can read them.

terminalRelay.logRetentionMinutes.markdownDescription: How long terminal history logs and finished command results are kept, in minutes. `0` turns history logs off and deletes finished results after a minute.

scripts.bump:patch: npm version patch --no-git-tag-version && npm run package
scripts.bump:minor: npm version minor --no-git-tag-version && npm run package
scripts.bump:major: npm version major --no-git-tag-version && npm run package
